_about: Hand-written meta descriptions for the 54 indexable learn-hindi-from-* pages (18 Nov 2026). Each one is distilled from that page's own verified country text in data/content/country-specifics.json (time-zone hook, first-language notes) — no new facts. Applied by tools/apply-country-seo.py; max 160 characters.
afghanistan: Learn Hindi from Afghanistan: Kabul is only an hour behind Delhi, and Dari speakers already know dost, kitab and shukriya. Free course, sound guide, tutors.
armenia: Learn Hindi from Armenia: a steady 1½-hour gap to India all year, and Armenian's own aspirated consonants give you a head start on k/kh. Free course and tutors.
azerbaijan: Learn Hindi from Azerbaijan: Baku is 1½ hours behind India, and shared Persian and Arabic words (kitab, dünya, xəbər) make vocabulary easier. Free course.
bahrain: Learn Hindi from Bahrain: lessons from 6:30 am to 7:30 pm Manama time, and Arabic speakers already have the kh and gh of Hindi. Free course, phrases, tutors.
bangladesh: Learn Hindi from Bangladesh: Bengali and Hindi share Sanskrit roots, so the new work is gender and the a-sound. Free self-paced course, phrases and tutors.
bhutan: Learn Hindi from Bhutan: tutors teach 9:30 am to 10:30 pm Thimphu time, the ngultrum is pegged to the rupee, and Nepali speakers start ahead. Free course.
brunei: Learn Hindi from Brunei: 2½ hours ahead of India, with Sanskrit words Malay still uses — bahasa, raja, guru. Free course, starter phrases and tutors.
cambodia: Learn Hindi from Cambodia: 1½ hours ahead of India, and Khmer's Sanskrit and Pali layer makes some Hindi words feel familiar. Free course, phrases, tutors.
canada: Learn Hindi from Canada: tutors' hours fall late at night or before lunch in Toronto; English and French speakers train the retroflex t and d. Free course.
ethiopia: Learn Hindi from Ethiopia: UTC+3 all year, and Amharic's ejective sounds make Hindi's aspirated and retroflex consonants less of a hurdle. Free course, tutors.
georgia: Learn Hindi from Georgia: 1½ hours behind India with no clock changes, and Georgian's aspirated–ejective contrast makes k/kh easy to hear. Free course, tutors.
haiti: Learn Hindi from Haiti: India is 10½ hours ahead, so early risers get the most slots; French and Creole nasal vowels help with main and hain. Free course.
india: Learn Hindi from inside India: for a move, a workplace or a partner's family. Tutors share your clock; gender agreement and ne are the usual work. Free course.
indonesia: Learn Hindi from Indonesia: evening lessons at 7 or 8 pm Jakarta time are easy to find, and Indonesian's Sanskrit words are a gift. Free course and tutors.
iran: Learn Hindi from Iran: 2 hours behind India all year, and Persian speakers already know dost, shahar, zindagi, bazaar and hundreds more. Free course, tutors.
iraq: Learn Hindi from Iraq: 2½ hours behind India with no clock changes, and Arabic speakers already have the sounds behind khabar and qaanoon. Free course, tutors.
israel: Learn Hindi from Israel: the Indian teaching day covers your morning and afternoon, and Hebrew's kh and gendered verbs feel familiar. Free course and tutors.
jordan: Learn Hindi from Jordan: a fixed 2½-hour gap to India since 2022, shared words like kitab and waqt, and the kh/gh sounds you already make. Free course, tutors.
kazakhstan: Learn Hindi from Kazakhstan: one zone, UTC+5, half an hour behind India; Kazakh's verb-last order makes Hindi sentences feel natural. Free course and tutors.
kosovo: Learn Hindi from Kosovo: 4½ hours behind India in winter, lessons across your morning and midday; Albanian's trilled r helps. Free course, phrases, tutors.
kuwait: Learn Hindi from Kuwait: lessons 6:30 am to 7:30 pm Kuwait time, before or after a shift, with Arabic's kh and q already in your mouth. Free course and tutors.
kyrgyzstan: Learn Hindi from Kyrgyzstan: lessons 9:30 am to 10:30 pm Bishkek time; Kyrgyz shares Hindi's verb-last order and postpositions. Free course, phrases, tutors.
laos: Learn Hindi from Laos: lessons 10:30 am to 11:30 pm Vientiane time. Hindi has no tones, so the work is gender, verb endings and clusters. Free course, tutors.
lebanon: Learn Hindi from Lebanon: the Indian teaching day covers your morning to late afternoon; Arabic kh/gh and French nasal vowels both help. Free course and tutors.
malaysia: Learn Hindi from Malaysia: evening lessons after work in Kuala Lumpur, prices shown in ringgit, and Sanskrit words Malay still uses. Free course and tutors.
maldives: Learn Hindi from the Maldives: half an hour behind India, with Dhivehi's Indo-Aryan roots and a long habit of Hindi films. Free self-paced course and tutors.
moldova: Learn Hindi from Moldova: tutors' hours start at 5:30 am in Chișinău in winter and end in the early evening; Romanian's rolled r and ă help. Free course.
myanmar: Learn Hindi from Myanmar: exactly one hour ahead of India at UTC+6:30, and Burmese's verb-last order makes Hindi sentences feel natural. Free course, tutors.
nepal: Learn Hindi from Nepal: 15 minutes ahead of India, the same Devanagari script and much shared vocabulary — the fastest start of all. Free course and tutors.
new-zealand: Learn Hindi from New Zealand: up to 7½ hours ahead of India, so a tutor's morning is your afternoon; English speakers train aspiration. Free course, tutors.
oman: Learn Hindi from Oman: lessons from 7:30 am to 8:30 pm Muscat time, and Arabic speakers already make kh, gh and q. Free course, starter phrases and tutors.
pakistan: Learn Hindi from Pakistan: Urdu speakers already speak everyday Hindi; the work is Devanagari and the Sanskrit-derived formal register. Free course and tutors.
palestine: Learn Hindi from Palestine: 3½ hours behind India in winter; shared words like kitab and duniya and the kh/gh sounds you already make. Free course and tutors.
peru: Learn Hindi from Peru: India is 10½ hours ahead, so early mornings in Lima have the most slots; Spanish's pure vowels and tapped r help. Free course and tutors.
philippines: Learn Hindi from the Philippines: 2½ hours ahead of India, with Sanskrit loans like guro and diwa in Filipino; retroflex sounds are the work. Free course.
poland: Learn Hindi from Poland: lessons across your morning and early afternoon; Polish consonant contrasts and cases prepare you for Hindi. Free course and tutors.
qatar: Learn Hindi from Qatar: lessons 6:30 am to 7:30 pm Doha time, before or after work, and Arabic's kh, gh and q already in place. Free course, phrases and tutors.
romania: Learn Hindi from Romania: 3½ hours behind India in winter, lessons across your morning and afternoon; your rolled r and ă are close to Hindi. Free course.
saudi-arabia: Learn Hindi from Saudi Arabia: lessons from 6:30 am to 7:30 pm in Riyadh and Jeddah, with Arabic's kh, gh and q already yours. Free course, phrases and tutors.
singapore: Learn Hindi from Singapore: 2½ hours ahead of India; Tamil speakers share the retroflex sounds, Malay speakers know the Sanskrit words. Free course and tutors.
south-africa: Learn Hindi from South Africa: a heritage language in KwaZulu-Natal since 1860, 3½ hours behind India; Zulu and Xhosa aspiration helps. Free course and tutors.
sri-lanka: Learn Hindi from Sri Lanka: the same clock as India, Sinhala's shared Sanskrit and Pali vocabulary, and Tamil's retroflex sounds. Free course, phrases, tutors.
syria: Learn Hindi from Syria: 2½ hours behind India all year, decades of Indian films, and Arabic's kh, gh and q already in your speech. Free course, phrases, tutors.
tajikistan: Learn Hindi from Tajikistan: lessons 8:30 am to 9:30 pm Dushanbe time, and Tajik's Persian vocabulary is the biggest head start in Central Asia. Free course.
thailand: Learn Hindi from Thailand: 1½ hours ahead of India, Sanskrit words like phasa and racha, and an ear already tuned to aspiration. Free course and tutors.
timor-leste: Learn Hindi from Timor-Leste: 3½ hours ahead of India, prices in US dollars with no conversion, and Portuguese nasal vowels that help. Free course and tutors.
turkiye: Learn Hindi from Türkiye: lessons 6:30 am to 7:30 pm Istanbul time all year; Turkish's verb-last order and postpositions match Hindi. Free course, tutors.
turkmenistan: Learn Hindi from Turkmenistan: half an hour behind India, with Turkmen's verb-last order and shared Persian words. Free self-paced course, phrases and tutors.
uae: Learn Hindi from the UAE: lessons 7:30 am to 8:30 pm Dubai time, built around work and shifts; many residents already speak some Hindi. Free course, tutors.
uk: Learn Hindi from the UK: tutors teach 3:30 am to 4:30 pm UK time in winter, so book a morning or lunchtime lesson; English speakers train aspiration.
usa: Learn Hindi from the United States: for heritage speakers and partners in Hindi-speaking families, across a 10½-hour gap from the East Coast. Free course.
uzbekistan: Learn Hindi from Uzbekistan: lessons 8:30 am to 9:30 pm Tashkent time; Uzbek's verb-last order and shared Persian and Arabic words help. Free course and tutors.
vietnam: Learn Hindi from Vietnam: lessons 10:30 am to 11:30 pm; Hindi has no tones, and Vietnamese already separates aspirated t from plain t. Free course and tutors.
yemen: Learn Hindi from Yemen: lessons 6:30 am to 7:30 pm all year with no clock changes, and Arabic's kh, gh and q already yours. Free course, phrases and tutors.
